verdict.rationale: Lindy docs confirm credentials are stored centrally and used for tool/shell access (lindy-docs-2), and admins can toggle a credential from private to shared with the whole workspace (lindy-docs-22), giving basic sharing/control. However, this is a binary private-vs-everyone toggle rather than granular per-user/per-team/role-based permissions, and there's no documented audit trail or fine-grained 'who can use which credential' management. missing for 10: granular role/team-based credential permissions, credential usage audit logs, admin-only credential governance controls.
